title: SkillMeat Instance Registry
description: Registry of managed SkillMeat instances across all editions and deployment methods

instances.description: Map of instance name to instance configuration

name.description: Unique identifier for this instance. Must match the parent key.

edition.description: SkillMeat edition. Controls backend storage (SQLite vs PostgreSQL) and auth.

deployment_method.description: How the instance is deployed and managed.

profile.description: Docker Compose profile in use. Required for compose and aws-ec2 methods.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the instance. Use 'localhost' for local compose deployments.

api_port.description: Port the FastAPI backend listens on. Default 8080.

web_port.description: Port the Next.js frontend listens on. Default 3000.

api_url.description: Full URL to reach the API from outside the instance (may differ from host:api_port for HTTPS/ALB).

web_url.description: Full URL to reach the web frontend.

status.description: Last known status. Updated by manage-instances.py or health-check.sh.

last_deployed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful deployment.

last_health_check.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last health check run.

terraform_root.description: Relative path from repo root to Terraform environment directory. Required for aws-ec2, aws-fargate, azure-aca methods. Null for compose-only instances.

ssh_key.description: Path to SSH private key for remote access. Required for aws-ec2 instances. Null otherwise.

ssh_port.description: SSH port. Default is 22; demo box uses 2222 via socat forwarder.

ssh_user.description: SSH username. Default ec2-user for Amazon Linux instances.

aws_profile.description: AWS CLI profile name for Terraform and CLI operations. Null for non-AWS instances.

azure_subscription.description: Azure subscription ID for Terraform operations. Null for non-Azure instances.

azure_resource_group.description: Azure resource group name where this instance is deployed.

compose_project_name.description: COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME override. Required when multiple compose projects share a directory (e.g., demo box with Backstage). Null to use directory basename.

container_runtime.description: Container runtime to use. 'auto' lets compose.sh detect. Demo box uses 'docker'; dev workstations use 'podman'.

notes.description: Free-form notes about this instance. Useful for documenting quirks or maintenance status.

type.description: Database type. local/local-auth editions use sqlite; enterprise uses postgresql.

connection.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Null for SQLite. May contain credentials — keep instances.json gitignored.

backup_bucket.description: S3 bucket name for automated backups. Null if not configured.

backup_prefix.description: S3 key prefix for backup files. Defaults to instance name if null.

last_backup.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful backup.

rds_identifier.description: RDS DB instance identifier for snapshot operations. Null for non-RDS PostgreSQL.
